en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a small wooden railway station building labeled "DALA" beside a set of tracks. A steam locomotive with carriages stands further down the line, with several people on the platform and near the train. Decorative woodwork trims the station's roof overhang, and a low fence and vegetation border the platform. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.
